## Muriel 1.1.2

**Downloads**
- **iPhone:** [ios-latest](https://github.com/cloverscripts/riff-muriel/releases/tag/ios-latest) (`Muriel.ipa`, install with SideStore, AltStore or Sideloadly)
- **Android:** [android-latest](https://github.com/cloverscripts/riff-muriel/releases/tag/android-latest) (`Muriel.apk`)
- **Windows:** installer below, or the portable exe on [windows-latest](https://github.com/cloverscripts/riff-muriel/releases/tag/windows-latest)
- **macOS:** `.dmg` / `.zip` below, for Apple Silicon and Intel. The app is unsigned: right-click → Open the first time.
- **Linux:** `.AppImage` below

**Fixed**
- **Songs that wouldn't play:** when YouTube refuses an upload ("This video is not available": blocked in your country, taken down, age-restricted), Muriel now plays another upload of the same song instead of failing
- **Error messages** have a proper background again instead of sitting on top of the list, and say what to do
- **Phone:** tapping a song in a playlist plays it instead of opening the artist; "⋯" opens the song's menu (Go to artist, Download, Remove from playlist and more)
- **Phone:** smoother scrolling on long lists like an artist's songs
